liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Listener recalls being captivated from the first notes of Casey Jones [13]
- **Black Peter** (1 review): Black Peter is cited as a lifelong favorite of the listener [16]
- **Drums** (1 review): The twelve-minute Drums jam is highlighted as a strong moment [11]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Listener praises the Not Fade Away performance as killer [15]
- Listener requests the acoustic set, noting Little Sadie is missing from official releases [9]

## The recordings

- **gd1970-02-14.sbd.miller.97644.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 28 songs; 227 min; rated 4.5/5 by 16 [1]. Said about its sound: Post-Drums section is described as explosive and incredible in performance [18]
- **gd70-02-14.early-late.sbd.cotsman.18115.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 27 songs; 217 min; rated 4.17/5 by 12 [2]
- **gd1970-02-14.166928.late.mtx.sirmick.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 23 songs; 141 min [5]. Said about its sound: Most of Caution and Feedback are missing from the audience recording [5]
- **gd1970-02-14.124495.cooper-berger.flac16**: audience recording; 23 songs; 145 min; rated 3.33/5 by 3 [6]. Said about its sound: Audience recording captures crowd chatter in a way soundboard cannot [6]

## Around the show

- Listener discovered the band via a Bears Choice compilation featuring these tunes [16]
- Early show is harder to find than the Dick's Pick release [7]
- Similar to the previous night, much music is absent from Dick's Picks Volume 4 [10]
- Music is good but not quite as good as the show on February 13 [11]
- Rated four stars because Dick's Picks Volume 4 omits several songs [14]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1970-02-14.sbd.miller.97644.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Master Reel (7 inch 1/2 Track at 15ips) -> Dat (48k) [1]. Also: Late show disc changes are noted as seamless in the transfer [1]
- **gd70-02-14.early-late.sbd.cotsman.18115.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Dick Latvala gave leftover tapes to David Gans for radio broadcast; Uploader lists set structure with specific song transitions and asterisks [2][8]
- **gd1970-02-14.166928.late.mtx.sirmick.flac16**: transferred by Matrix by SirMick; source: Matrix mix sbd 80% / aud 20% [5]. Also: Audience source was repaired, patched, and had reverb reduced using iZotope RX10 [5]
- **gd1970-02-14.124495.cooper-berger.flac16**: taped by Jim Cooper; transferred by Rob Berger; source: source: aud cassette master taped by Jim Cooper; hitachi trq-222 deck nak bx-300 > benchmark adc1 > adobe audition cs6 > tlh flac; transferred & seeded by Rob… [6]
